value.answer: Glad you reached out. If things feel urgent, Distress Centres of Greater Toronto is free 24/7 by phone, chat or text, and ConnexOntario is open 24 hours at 1-866-531-2600 to point you to the right service. For ongoing help, private therapy isn't covered by OHIP, but many employer extended health plans cover it, and your work EAP may include a few free sessions. Free options in Toronto: Ontario Structured Psychotherapy (short-term CBT for adults with depression or anxiety), BounceBack Ontario (guided self-help for ages 15+ with mild to moderate anxiety or depression), and Family Service Toronto (fees based on income). To find a private therapist, Psychotherapy Referral Service or First Session (free consultations) are good places to start.
